copy.headline: Rams and Cowboys top Week 12 uniforms
copy.caption:
The NFL on Thanksgiving is a classic tradition, and the uniforms are as much a part of the games as a celebratory turkey leg. But, this year a game will be played on Thanksgiving Eve for the first time.

And it's only right that the matchup will include the debut of a uniform, too. The Los Angeles Rams are wearing their "Fearsome White" threads against the Green Bay Packers on Wednesday.

story.title: Rams and Cowboys top Week 12 uniforms
story.summary: Here's a look at what each NFL team is wearing in Week 12, led by an alternate uniform for the Los Angeles Rams. The NFL on Thanksgiving is a classic tradition, and the uniforms are as much a part of the games as a celebratory turkey leg. But, this year a game will be played on Thanksgiving Eve for the first time. And it's only right that the matchup will include the debut of a uniform, too. The Los Angeles Rams are wearing their "Fearsome White" threads against the Green Bay Packers on Wednesday. The all-white look is inspired by the Rams' "Fearsome Foursome" defensive line from the 1960s and early 1970s. A modern "Rams Royal" lid includes white horns, white facemask, new 3D bumper logos and "Rams" on the front.
